stories.title: Horror Story — Walking Out of the Shallows

WALKING: Ottilie strides down the pale green hallway toward the camera, phone light raised, the closed door of Room 14 waiting ahead, shadows stretching long behind her.

stories.title: Mystery Story — Two Sets of Footprints

scenes.v: At the lighthouse's stairwell: WALKING: Petra climbs the lighthouse's spiral iron staircase toward the camera, lantern raised, her own boot-prints dark in dust behind her, and beside them a second, smaller wet print she has not made.
scenes.c: Every morning Petra finds a second set of footprints on the stairs, though she has lived in the lighthouse quite alone for eleven years.

scenes.v: CLOSE: inside the lighthouse's stairwell, Petra crouches low over the iron steps, lantern close to the dust, studying a bootprint identical to her own beside the smaller wet print, her face uncertain.
scenes.c: She wonders, at first, if her own boots are tricking her, damp twice over from the climb.

scenes.v: WIDE: inside the lantern room at the top of the lighthouse, Petra stands small before the great glass lens, morning light pouring through, the wet print glistening on the floor below the dripping lamp glass.
scenes.c: The answer was always above her: condensation from the old lamp glass, dripping down each night.

stories.title: Mystery Story — The Hour It Arrives

scenes.v: CLOSE: Aldo's face fills the frame, deep shadows under his eyes, in the museum hallway, his gaze fixed past us toward the brass elevator doors as a faint chime sounds.
scenes.c: They told him the museum elevator had not run in years, its power cut, its shaft sealed.

scenes.v: OVER THE SHOULDER: over Hedda's shoulder in the museum hallway, she faces the museum elevator's brass doors, flashlight raised, while unseen pipes behind the walls seem the obvious source of the sound.
scenes.c: Hedda insisted it was only old pipes groaning behind the plaster, nothing more.

scenes.v: FROM BELOW: looking up at the museum elevator's brass doors in the museum hallway, Aldo stands close, flashlight raised, as the dusty velvet rope lies fallen at his feet, untouched for years.
scenes.c: Then Aldo remembered the rope, fallen that very first week, never retied, never touched again.

stories.title: Horror Story — Circling in the Dark

scenes.v: WALKING: Delphine strides toward the camera through the dark rink lobby, flashlight beam cutting ahead, keyring jangling at her belt, the shadowed rink floor stretching away behind her through open double doors.
scenes.c: The old roller rink had been closed for hours when Delphine began her rounds, flashlight slicing the dark. Every night she checked the locks, the lights, the silent, empty floor.
